tasks.question: What are the key design and compatibility differences between gzip and zstd relevant to offline backup and real-time transfer?
How do gzip and zstd compare in throughput and latency at comparable compression levels, and how do data types affect this?
Which trade-offs favor gzip vs zstd for offline backup scenarios across compression levels and data types?
Which trade-offs favor gzip vs zstd for real-time transfer scenarios considering latency, throughput, and compatibility?
What same-benchmark independent tests exist comparing gzip and zstd, and what do they show without universal multipliers?
